Version A feels right to me. When I paste a link I've already saved, it told me it's already saved and took me straight to the existing bookmark, highlighted, so I can just open or edit that one. That's exactly what I'd want — one link, one bookmark, and it quietly points me to the copy I already have.

Version B I'd actually steer away from, because offering "save another copy" is the one thing I don't want. The whole point for me is that I never end up with two of the same link cluttering things up. If I paste something I've saved before, I want it to land me on the existing one, not give me a way to duplicate it. So please go with A, and drop the "save another copy" path.

And you've got the detection basis right — it should match on the actual destination address, and never quietly make a second copy.
